requirement: Map a create-clinical-metric command to a new ClinicalMetric: copy the name, code, description, version, and publisher, mark it applied, start with an empty rule collection, let the entity generate its ID, and always report success.

preconditions.text: The mapper is constructed without dependencies

inputs.text: CURB-65 metric: name, code CURB-65, description, version 2002-2003, publisher BTS
PSI metric: name, code PSI, description, version 1997, publisher PORT
IDSA/ATS metric: name, code IDSA/ATS, description, version 2026, publisher IDSA and ATS
PSI command mapped through the dependency overload

returns.text: Success at ApplicationStatus.Success with a new ClinicalMetric
Name, code, description, version, and publisher are copied
The metric is applied with no rules and a generated non-empty ID
The dependency overload produces the same model as the plain overload

exception_text: No unhandled exception; the mapper always returns a successful result
